scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/simple-collector run build && npm --prefix apps/backend-producer run build && npm --prefix apps/frontend-producer run build && npm --prefix apps/test-bot run build
scripts.type-check: npm --prefix apps/simple-collector run type-check && npm --prefix apps/backend-producer run type-check && npm --prefix apps/frontend-producer run type-check && npm --prefix apps/test-bot run type-check
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/simple-collector test && npm --prefix apps/backend-producer test && npm --prefix apps/frontend-producer test && npm --prefix apps/test-bot test
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/simple-collector install && npm --prefix apps/backend-producer install && npm --prefix apps/frontend-producer install && npm --prefix apps/test-bot install
scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' EXIT; node test/opensnowcat-server.mjs & npm --prefix apps/simple-collector run dev & npm --prefix apps/backend-producer run dev & npm --prefix apps/frontend-producer run dev & wait
scripts.e2e: bash -c 'trap "kill $P0 $P1 $P2 $P3 2>/dev/null" EXIT; node test/opensnowcat-server.mjs >/dev/null 2>&1 & P0=$!; npm --prefix apps/simple-collector run dev >/dev/null 2>&1 & P1=$!; npm --prefix apps/backend-producer run dev >/dev/null 2>&1 & P2=$!; npm --prefix apps/frontend-producer run dev >/dev/null 2>&1 & P3=$!; for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -sf http://localhost:8080/health >/dev/null && curl -sf http://localhost:5000/health >/dev/null && curl -sf http://localhost:4000/api/health >/dev/null && curl -sf http://localhost:3000/ >/dev/null && break; sleep 1; done; node --no-warnings apps/test-bot/dist/index.js "$@"' --
